headline.en: UNI ripped +38% on fee-expansion proposals but math still says net inflationary; rally is narrative, not mechanics.
headline.zh: UNI 一周暴涨 38%,由 fee expansion(手续费扩张)提案驱动,但通胀数学未改,反弹靠叙事而非基本面。

keyChanges.en: Price at $8.63 sits 45% above the $5.96 treasury burn anchor — UNI has exited the DAO's own implied fair-value zone.
keyChanges.zh: 现价 $8.63 较 $5.96 国库销毁隐含成本高出 45%,已脱离 DAO 自己标定的公允价值区间。

keyChanges.en: Two active Protocol Fee Expansion proposals (Arc, Robinhood Chain) are the actual catalyst behind the +38% 7d move, not organic flow.
keyChanges.zh: 两项活跃的 Protocol Fee Expansion 提案(Arc、Robinhood Chain)是 7 日 +38% 的真正催化剂,并非自然买盘。

keyChanges.en: Annualized revenue $160M generates only 3.15M UNI buyback vs 20M emission — still net inflationary at +1.90%/yr.
keyChanges.zh: 年化收入 $160M 仅回购 3.15M UNI,而年增发 20M,净通胀依然为 +1.90%/年。

contrarianObservation.en: If Arc or Robinhood Chain fee expansions pass and lift protocol revenue 50-80%, the burn/emission ratio flips deflationary near current prices — the market may be front-running exactly this, and shorts get run over on any positive vote.
contrarianObservation.zh: 若 Arc 或 Robinhood Chain 手续费扩张通过并推动协议收入上升 50-80%,回购/增发比例将在当前价位附近翻转为通缩;市场可能正是在抢跑这一情景,任一提案获批空头将被碾压。

watchNext.en: Temp Check outcomes for Arc and Robinhood Chain fee expansions — these directly change the buyback math.
watchNext.zh: Arc 与 Robinhood Chain 手续费扩张的 Temp Check 结果,直接改写回购数学模型。

watchNext.en: Any reintroduction of the real-yield RFC (buyback → stakers); absent from top-5 forum threads today, which is telling.
watchNext.zh: real-yield RFC(回购分配给 stakers)是否重新提出;今日论坛 top 5 未见,信号意味浓厚。

watchNext.en: $8.00 level — losing it confirms rally exhaustion; holding opens a retest of $10 psychological.
watchNext.zh: $8.00 关键支撑,失守则确认反弹见顶;守住则开启 $10 心理关口测试。

fullReasoning.en: The tape looks bullish and the mechanics don't. UNI is up 38% in a week but the drivers are two governance proposals (Arc, Robinhood Chain fee expansions) that haven't passed and haven't yet moved a dollar of revenue. Meanwhile the core problem is unchanged: $160M annualized protocol revenue funds ~$27M of buybacks, which at $8.63 burns only 3.15M UNI against 20M emission. Net supply is still growing +1.9%/yr. Price now sits 45% above the $5.96 treasury burn anchor — the DAO's own revealed fair-value mark — and well through the $4-7 institutional accumulation zone, meaning the marginal buyer here is momentum, not value. Derivatives don't scream froth (funding 0.00%, OI just $53M against a $5.37B cap), so this isn't a leverage flush setup; it's more likely a slow bleed as the fee-expansion catalyst either passes (already priced) or slips. The absence of any real-yield RFC in the top forum threads is the quiet negative — the single most important structural upgrade for UNI is not on the agenda. Stance is bearish 1-4 weeks, medium confidence because a surprise vote outcome on Arc could invalidate the setup fast.
fullReasoning.zh: 盘面偏多,基本面不配合。UNI 一周上涨 38%,但驱动来自两项尚未通过、尚未产生一分钱收入的治理提案(Arc、Robinhood Chain 的 fee expansion)。核心问题未变:年化协议收入 $160M 对应约 $27M 回购预算,在 $8.63 价位仅能销毁 3.15M UNI,而年增发 20M,净供给仍以 +1.9%/年扩张。当前价格已高出 $5.96 国库销毁锚定价 45%,即 DAO 自己揭示的公允价值参考,并明显穿越 $4-7 机构建仓区间,意味着此处边际买家是动量资金而非价值买家。衍生品端并无过热信号:funding rate 0.00%,OI 仅 $53M,相对 $5.37B 市值可忽略,因此这不是杠杆爆仓型顶部,更像 fee expansion 催化剂兑现(利好出尽)或推迟(叙事失血)后的慢跌结构。更关键的沉默信号是:top 5 论坛主题中完全没有 real-yield RFC 的踪影,而这才是 UNI 从反身性资产切换为现金流资产的唯一结构性升级。1-4 周维度看空,中等信心;若 Arc 提案意外快速通过,该判断会被迅速证伪,故不给 high。
